description: This file defines the interface for the INativeJS component within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It declares a virtual interface with methods to initialize, deinitialize, create, run, and terminate NativeJS applications, as well as to run JavaScript code and retrieve existing applications.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: Interface providing methods to manage NativeJS applications within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin with the specified Wayland display.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with specified options.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs a specified NativeJS application given its ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within a specified application context.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves details of existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a running NativeJS application by ID.
